name: adsb-receiver
description: Decode Mode S and ADS-B downlink frames at 1090 MHz from a 2 MS/s unsigned 8-bit baseband (RTL-SDR).

rf.description: IQ at exactly 2 MS/s tuned to 1090 MHz

packets.description: The frames: 14 bytes of DF 17 and 18 with a correct CRC-24 (CRC_OK), 7 bytes of short frames with flag bit 16, and the input index of their preamble
